result.reason: The operative language substantively reaches the preferred position: Vendor indemnifies Customer and its Affiliates for third-party IP, legal-compliance, Vendor-caused Customer Data breach, and gross-negligence/wilful-misconduct claims; it includes standard procedures and narrowly limits Customer's indemnity. The IP exclusions and remedies are customary and consistent with the fallback, while unrelated terms remain unchanged. Drafting quality is reduced because the inserted provisions are not numbered even though they refer to Sections 20.1(a) and 20.5, leaving broken or ambiguous cross-references. The margin comment also cites Sections 19.4 and 30.5 inconsistently with the supplied text.
